stageDefinitions.operational: Code/tests/docs support an active demo path in GitHub.
stageDefinitions.supporting-operational: Supports the demo as library, proof, receipt, telemetry, brand, trust, or workflow infrastructure.
stageDefinitions.blocked-upstream: Requires upstream proof/CI/release correction before broad claims.
stageDefinitions.proxy-ready: Patch/artifact exists but target repo write or owner action is required.
stageDefinitions.release-payload: Included in checksummed/signed or generated payload artifacts.
stageDefinitions.generated-mirror: Published/generated Hugging Face mirror of GitHub-backed content.
stageDefinitions.staged: Prepared but not public/verified/live enough for active claims.
stageDefinitions.excluded-until-funded: Visible scaffold, intentionally outside active-demo scope.

huggingFaceScope.countMeaning: Items returned by the author-filtered public APIs; not the authenticated organization total.
huggingFaceScope.revisionFields: Every item has sha and lastModified snapshot evidence plus a cardSemanticSha256 claim digest at observedAt; --check verifies retained revisions, rejects card and curated-tag drift, and ignores only complete, valid later source-only revision changes and Hugging Face-generated dataset size, modality, format, or library tags.

Repointed from the phantom path Lutar/Gate/MoralGrounding.lean to the real kernel-checked theorem MoralGroundingTheorem (with corollary P_moral_iff_conjunction) in Lutar/DoctrineV3/MoralGrounding.lean (zero sorry, zero axiom). The Lean proof establishes the structural core: the moral-safety predicate P_moral decomposes into a finite six-category harm conjunction provable by exhaustive case analysis (Doctrine V3 Section 6). The 0.95 numeric floor and ORCID requirement are the runtime predicate (tested separately); they are not encoded in Lean because they require a probability-space axiom, as disclosed in the Lean file (Section 6.4).
